title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.31139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other opt

translated_title: Deneb-Vritra：通过恢复词元表示与注意力的阻断方法检验描述、边与名称
translated_abstract: Laya 是一个拥有 421M 参数的编码器模型，可在一次前向传播中回答关于一段文本的问题：每个答案选项写作“名称+描述”的形式，并获得一个标记词元，网络在每个标记处读取一个得分。我们首先确认，这类模型在选项名称与描述相矛盾时会跟随名称作答；问题在于这一行为发生在网络的哪个位置。我们对其进行了定位。在 951 个合成问题上，我们将每个名称移动到另一个选项的描述上，并统计模型选中名称正确的选项的频率（即“名称捷径”）：官方发布的检查点为 53%，我们的微调版本 v1 为 59%，采用名称随机化训练的微调版本为 11%。在 320 条样本上，在该 28 层模型的第 14 至 17 层阻断每个标记词元对其自身名称词元的注意力，可将 v1 的捷径比例从 67% 降至 16%（在两个未参与组件筛选的保留模式上为 19%），而使用原始名称时的准确率保持在 90%；阻断标记指向问题、其他选项……
tldr: 本研究在 421M 参数的多项选择问答编码器 Laya 中定位了模型依赖选项名称而非描述作答的“名称捷径”发生的网络位置，并证明在第 14 至 17 层阻断标记词元对其名称词元的注意力可将捷径行为从 67% 降至 16%，同时保持 90% 的原始准确率。
en_tdlr: This work localizes the "name shortcut" in a 421M-parameter multiple-choice QA encoder, showing that blocking attention from marker tokens to their name tokens in layers 14–17 reduces the shortcut from 67% to 16% while preserving 90% accuracy.
